table.note: no table: no column was matched to a sample; agent: The per-sample MatrixMarket files (header "coordinate integer general", Cell Ranger 3.0.2) hold integer UMI counts per gene (features.tsv, Ensembl IDs) per cell (barcodes.tsv), so they are raw counts. This is single-cell data: the columns of each matrix are cells, not samples, so no single column holds a whole sample's counts and neither GSM4396313 nor GSM4396314 is given in sources.
